title.zh: 有序逐电流丝磁响应矩阵

summary: Build target-row/source-column matrices for ordered circular-filament psi, BR, and BZ responses.

identity.direction: target points and optional source rows to response matrices
identity.definition: Each source column is evaluated at every target in caller order; source weights are applied once.
identity.model: Axisymmetric ideal circular-filament response with explicit zero-self entries.
identity.geometry: Targets and sources may be different finite cylindrical point tables.
identity.coordinates: R,Z in metres; source weights dimensionless; psi Wb/rad/A and fields T/A.
identity.boundary: Exact source-target coincidence is zeroed for each matrix entry; zero-radius or zero-weight sources contribute zero.
assumptions: Inputs are finite real arrays with nonnegative radii.
Omitting rzw makes targets the unit-weight source set.
Explicit source rows may repeat because columns remain independent.

inputs.name: rz_pts
inputs.description: 按调用者顺序给出的目标R,Z。

inputs.name: rzw
inputs.description: 有序源R,Z和可选有符号权重；None使用目标为单位权重源。
inputs.constraints: 源半径非负，省略第三列时权重1。

outputs.name: psi
outputs.description: 目标行、源列的磁通响应。
outputs.constraints: 有限；精确重合离散置零。

outputs.name: BR
outputs.description: 目标行、源列的径向场响应。
outputs.constraints: 保留有符号权重和实际高度差。

outputs.name: BZ
outputs.description: 目标行、源列的轴向场响应。
outputs.constraints: 轴上目标使用解析极限。

preconditions: Inputs are finite real arrays with nonnegative radii.
Omitting rzw makes targets the unit-weight source set.
supported: Irregular ordering, signed weights, implicit unit sources, axis limits, and matrix current contraction.
excluded: Finite-conductor self-fields, extreme-scale guarantees, and physical-equilibrium claims.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError is raised for malformed, complex, nonfinite, negative-radius, or duplicate positive-radius implicit sources.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError from an unrepresentable kernel response propagates.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; each matrix entry is evaluated directly.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial matrix is returned after a failed source evaluation.

provenance.license_status: Pleiades-derived source portions retain the MIT notice in licenses/Pleiades-MIT.txt; SciRel has no separate distribution-license declaration.

example.description: Build two-target, three-source response matrices and apply a separate current vector.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.electromagnetism import green_response_matrices
targets=np.array([[0.,.2],[.8,-.3]])
sources=np.array([[.4,.1,1.],[1.2,-.7,-2.],[.6,.9,.5]])
gpsi,gbr,gbz=green_response_matrices(targets,sources)
assert gpsi.shape==(2,3) and np.all(gpsi[0]==0.)
field_bz=gbz@np.array([3.,-4.,2.])
assert np.all(np.isfinite(field_bz))
example.expected: Each matrix has shape (2,3); the first target is on the axis so psi is zero there, and the contracted BZ is finite.

scope: 非对称坐标的独立方位角积分。
混合符号、非单位电流、独立源目标换序。
默认单位源、轴上解析极限、精确自项和非法输入。
verification.evidence_ceiling: 具名域的独立数值关系与组合验证，非实验或有限导体资格。
known_limitations: 离散零自项不描述导体自场。
